Career & Counseling Services

Career Guidance and Counselling

Room: 103, Ground Floor, Building: 4, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

  • The Career Guidance and Counselling Office at BUBT is committed to supporting students in achieving their academic, personal, and professional aspirations. The office provides a wide range of services designed to help students explore career opportunities, identify their strengths and interests, and make informed decisions about their future.


    Through personalized career counseling, professional development workshops, seminars, training sessions, and one-on-one guidance, students gain valuable insights into career planning, employability skills, and workplace expectations. The office also assists students in developing essential competencies such as communication, leadership, teamwork, problem-solving, and interview techniques, enabling them to become confident and competitive professionals.


    In addition to career development, the office offers counseling services that promote students' personal growth, emotional well-being, and resilience, helping them navigate academic and personal challenges effectively. By fostering self-awareness, confidence, and lifelong learning, the Career Guidance and Counselling Office empowers students to achieve their full potential and successfully transition from university to the professional world.

Services of Our Office

Career Guidance & Counseling

The office provides personalized career counseling to help students identify their interests, skills, and career goals, enabling informed academic and professional decisions.

Career Development & Employability Skills

CGC organizes training on CV writing, cover letters, interview preparation, professional communication, leadership, and workplace ethics to enhance students’ job readiness.

Internship & Job Placement Support

The office facilitates internships, on-campus recruitment, job fairs, and employer networking to connect students with industry opportunities and improve graduate employability.

International Affairs & Study Abroad Guidance

The office supports students pursuing higher education abroad by providing counseling, application assistance, credit transfer support, and guidance on international admission processes.

Industry & Alumni Engagement

CGC maintains strong relationships with industry partners and alumni to create career opportunities, mentorship, and professional networking for students.

International Collaboration & MoU Facilitation

CGC manages Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with foreign universities to promote academic exchange, research collaboration, and international mobility opportunities.
